selected_configuration.selection_basis: The terminal-value candidate had the lowest complete formal-period and full-year cost among tested policies for both strategies. Actual settlement never subtracts terminal credit. This is same-year model development, not independent-year validation.

selection_disclosure: Fixed candidate policies were compared on the same 2025 data used for model development. Each executed decision and internal forecast selection is causal; there is no independent-year test.
